name: deeplabv3-lulc-segmentation
description: A PyTorch implementation of DeepLabV3+ with an EfficientNet backbone for Land Use/Land Cover (LULC) semantic segmentation.

paragraphs: DeepLabV3+ LULC Segmentation is a production-ready, state-of-the-art semantic segmentation framework for Land Use/Land Cover mapping from satellite imagery, offering end-to-end solutions from data preprocessing to intelligent land cover analysis

whatItDoes.text: DeepLabV3+ LULC Segmentation is a production-ready, state-of-the-art semantic segmentation framework for Land Use/Land Cover mapping from satellite imagery, offering end-to-end solutions from data preprocessing to intelligent land cover analysis
